coverage_limits: This audit verifies saved evaluation outputs and full 6000-step training log/metrics/curve. Model and DCP integrity are audited separately.

This audit does not assert full original training datasets, simulator assets, Docker/container environment, or all historical LoRA/teammate checkpoints are backed up; a separate remote inventory is required.
File SHA256 checks establish that saved videos equal the transfer manifests; full video decoding was not repeated.
The evaluation uses valid-episode retry: two runs can admit different actual seeds when setup fails. Exact seed comparisons are stored per task.
